method: For every saved EXP-0010 predicted box, reprojected with the devkit's own boxes_to_sensor()+box_in_image() into each of the sample's 4 cameras. This is a geometric visibility PROXY, not per-call provenance -- EXP-0010's output does not record which camera produced each box, and overlapping camera frustums mean a box can legitimately reproject validly into more than one camera.
